plugin.notMapped: the {amp} amp isn't mapped yet — applying to {fallback}
chat.error.send: The AI couldn't answer. Check your connection and API key, then try again.
chat.error.auth: The AI provider rejected the API key. Check it in Settings and try again.
chat.error.noAccess: This API key doesn't have permission from the AI provider. Check your account plan.
chat.error.modelUnavailable: The chosen model isn't available for this API key. Pick another model.
chat.error.connection: Couldn't reach the AI provider. Check your internet connection and try again.
chat.error.rate: The AI provider is limiting requests right now. Wait a moment and try again.
chat.error.truncated: The AI's answer was cut off before it finished. Ask for a simpler rig — fewer scenes or effects.
chat.error.blocked: The AI provider blocked this response under its content policy. Try describing the tone a different way.
chat.error.validation: The AI returned an incomplete or invalid rig. Try again, maybe phrasing it a bit differently.
chat.error.noProvider: No AI provider is configured. Add an API key in Settings.
shell.plugin.title: Plugins
shell.composer.placeholder: Describe the tone, or ask for an adjustment — "less bass on the riff"
chat.mode.title: Application mode
chat.mode.manualDesc: You choose when to apply, by clicking each tone's card.
chat.mode.autoDesc: Applies automatically when the AI answers with a single tone. Two or more suggestions stay manual.
chat.model.title: AI model
chat.model.empty: No models available — add an API key in Settings.
chat.memoryLost: This conversation's history couldn't be reused — it was created with another AI provider or an older app version. The text is here, but the model doesn't remember it: describe again what you want to adjust.
chat.card.expandAria: See how this tone was built
history.delete.title: Delete conversation
history.delete.ask: Delete this conversation? This can't be undone.
history.delete.label: Delete {title}
about.tagline: Guitar tones in natural language, applied by MIDI CC to Neural DSP plugins.
chat.invite.heading: Build your tone
chat.invite.text: Describe the sound you want and OpenTimbre calculates the plugin parameters.
settings.title: Settings
settings.guitarSub: The AI uses this to recommend the right pickup and technique in each scene.
settings.aiSub: The keys stay only on this computer, encrypted by your Windows account. They never come back to the screen — after saving, only the hint of the last characters.
settings.appearanceSub: In the dark theme the window blends into the plugin; in the light theme it matches the rest of Windows. System follows the OS, and changes with it.
settings.window.onTopDesc: The window stays above the plugin instead of disappearing behind it.
settings.window.dimDesc: Stays translucent while you play, and returns when you click it.
settings.ai.providerAuto: Auto — the first with a valid key
settings.ai.forced: Provider is forced by the {env} environment variable.
settings.ai.noProvider: Add an API key below to use the AI.
settings.keys.unreadable: Saved key can't be opened on this account.
settings.keys.unencrypted: Stored unencrypted — the OS keychain isn't available.
